findings.finding: The native owner initializes Overall; new windows inherit that owner selection, saved windows restore native private session state, and the native setter writes owner/pane/saved state.
The native Current radio uses the same owner setter rejected by the actual Forever taint test. Invoking its callback from addon code is not a new supported configuration API.
The 13 Edit Mode settings contain no session/default-Current option.
The source-exposed meter CVars control enablement and reset on entering an instance. No Current-default CVar was found; this source search does not prove an undocumented CVar cannot exist.

An addon-owned replacement cannot presently guarantee native combat drilldown: sourceGUID is conditionally secret and source queries accept secret arguments only when untainted. Display sinks for opaque totals do not establish interactive parity.

ResetAllCombatSessions each fight, which discards native history.
Silently substitute a reduced custom renderer or claim manual native selection satisfies the automatic requirement.
